import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {chromium} from 'playwright';
const browser=await chromium.launch({channel:'chrome',headless:true});
const results=[];
try {
 const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:1000}}), errors=[];
 page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
 await page.goto('__FIXTURE_ORIGIN__');
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'New entry',exact:true}).click();
 console.log('step:new entry');
 const name=page.getByLabel('Name',{exact:true});
 await name.fill('Silver limousine');
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Save entry',exact:true}).click();
 await page.getByText('Saved revision 1',{exact:true}).waitFor();console.log('checkpoint');results.push('create record');
 await name.fill('Black limousine');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Save entry',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText('Saved revision 2',{exact:true}).waitFor();console.log('checkpoint');results.push('append revision');
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Read revision',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText('Silver limousine',{exact:true}).waitFor();
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Restore into draft',exact:true}).click();assert.equal(await name.inputValue(),'Silver limousine');
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Save entry',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText('Saved revision 3',{exact:true}).waitFor();console.log('checkpoint');results.push('restore appends revision');
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Venues',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'New entry',exact:true}).click();await name.fill('Garden venue');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Save entry',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText('Saved revision 1',{exact:true}).waitFor();
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Fleet',exact:true}).click();assert.equal(await name.inputValue(),'Silver limousine');console.log('checkpoint');results.push('collection isolation');
 await name.fill('Unsaved draft');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Venues',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Fleet',exact:true}).click();assert.equal(await name.inputValue(),'Unsaved draft');console.log('checkpoint');results.push('draft retained across selection');
 await page.evaluate(()=>window.fixture.conflictNext=true);await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Save entry',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText('A newer revision is available',{exact:true}).waitFor();assert.equal(await name.inputValue(),'Unsaved draft');assert.equal(await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Save entry',exact:true}).isDisabled(),true);console.log('checkpoint');results.push('conflict preserves draft');
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Reload saved entry',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Continue',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText('Saved revision 3',{exact:true}).waitFor();assert.equal(await name.inputValue(),'Silver limousine');
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Archive entry',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Continue',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText('Saved revision 4',{exact:true}).waitFor();console.log('checkpoint');results.push('archive appends revision');
 await page.reload();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Venues',exact:true}).click();await name.waitFor();assert.equal(await name.inputValue(),'Garden venue');console.log('checkpoint');results.push('save survives reopen');
 await page.setViewportSize({width:390,height:844});await page.screenshot({path:'__FIXTURE_ROOT__/mobile.png',fullPage:true});assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth),true);console.log('checkpoint');results.push('mobile no horizontal overflow');
 await name.focus();await page.keyboard.press('Tab');assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>document.activeElement!==document.body),true);console.log('checkpoint');results.push('keyboard focus');
 assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);console.log(JSON.stringify({results,errors},null,2));
} catch(error){console.error(error);process.exitCode=1} finally {await browser.close()}
